newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to reach 4,320 then ease to 4,310.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to reach 4,320 then ease to 4,310.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may be able to reach the 4,315-4,320 area on Thursday but owing to a lack of sufficient buying interest, it may then slip back towards 4,310, technical anaysts said.
A select group of stocks will once again carry the market upwards and these will include shares in the financial, tobacco, transport, telecommunications and pharmaceutical sectors.
The market showed its resilience on Wednesday by staying near the 4,300 level and today's action should give a chance for investors to guage its true mettle, they added.
By 0725 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 18.0, to 4,312.6.

Market breadth for the FTSE had been weak yesterday with only 43 percent of FTSE stocks showing an advance. This would indicate the bulls have not fully stamped their authority on the market and the bears lack the conviction to pull the market down too much, analysts said.
The bulls would now argue that by recapturing the 4,300 level and overcoming its 25 day moving average this morning, the FTSE can be expected to trend higher.
But the bears will point out that the market has lacked breadth as well as volume and that the medium-term downtrend since mid-March is still in place.

A daily close chart of the FTSE since the end of March shows that over the past few weeks the index has merely shuffled between 4,210 and 4,315 so that for the time being its motion will be confined within that region, analysts said.
